data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 ABSTRACTS to a false generalization of SRC_004: the claim that n≡-2 mod 35 captures all solutions is an overgeneralization of the observation that 3≡-2 mod 5 — it projects one modulus's residue onto both, ignoring that 4≡-3 mod 7 (different offset). This is the abstract step whose failure SRC_004 diagnoses. Refuted if 4≡-2 mod 7 (it gives -3, so the abstraction is unsound), or if 18∉{35k-2} (18 mod 35=18≠33, confirming the abstraction misses the true solution class).
